clean_description: In 'Call for the Dead', George Smiley, an intelligence officer, investigates the apparent suicide of Samuel Fennan, a former agent he had recently interviewed. As Smiley delves deeper, he uncovers layers of deception and intrigue within the Cold War espionage landscape. This novel marks the beginning of Smiley's complex character and le Carré's exploration of moral ambiguity in the world of spies.
